title: Ready for B1 - Test 5 - Part 1 (Multiple Choice Pictures)
instruction: Bạn sẽ nghe 7 đoạn hội thoại ngắn. Với mỗi câu, chọn đáp án đúng A, B hoặc C.
fullScript:
Question 1. What is she wearing?
Dad: Oh, you've got changed. Are you going somewhere?
Daughter: Yes, dad. It's the school party tonight, and I'm thinking of wearing this. What do you think?
Dad: Well, the jacket's very nice and the skirt is all right. But don't you think that belt's rather thick and heavy?
Daughter: Yes, I see what you mean. It doesn't go with this light skirt. Perhaps a thin one would be better.
Dad: Well, why don't you go and try?
Daughter: Yes, good idea.

Question 2. Where is the clock?
Person 1: Oh no, it looks like Aunt Meg has moved all the sitting room furniture again.
Person 2: Oh yes. Wasn't the clock between the shelves and the mirror before?
Person 1: No, there's no space for a clock there. I think it used to be above the mirror.
Person 2: Oh yes, you're right. Now it's up there above the shelves.
Person 1: She probably put it there so we can look at it while eating.
Person 2: Yes, probably.

Question 3. What arrived in the post today?
Person 1: Well, well, it's your lucky day.
Person 2: Really? Why's that?
Person 1: The posters come. There's a postcard for you and a parcel.
Person 2: Isn't there anything else? I'm expecting a letter from Sandra. Is that it?
Person 1: No, sorry. There's just the postcard, parcel. Oh, and a couple of letters.
Person 2: For me? They don't look very interesting.
Person 1: No, they're for me, and they're probably just a couple of bills.

Question 4. Which picture do they like?
Friend 1: This gallery isn't very good. I don't like many of the pictures.
Friend 2: Yeah. You see that one with the castle in it? It's awful.
Friend 1: Yes. And look at the countryside in the background. It's terrible. I could paint better than that. What do you think of the flowers in the vase?
Friend 2: Well, they're not bad at all. Better than the painting of the old woman.
Friend 1: Yes, you're right.

Question 5. What does she want for her birthday?
Parent: Well, it's not long until the big day, Alice. What would you like to get this year?
Alice: I really hope I don't get the same as last year.
Parent: Why? What did you get then?
Alice: Some books, but they weren't very interesting. I'd be pleased with some jewellery.
Parent: Didn't you get some clothes last year too?
Alice: Oh yes, I forgot, but I want something different this year.
Parent: Well, you'll see on your birthday.

Question 6. What hobby will he try next?
Friend: So, are you going to join another club this annual?
Boy: Well, I'm always looking for something new to do in my spare time.
Friend: You're good at art. Have you thought about painting?
Boy: Yes, I've considered it, but I think I'd like to do something that helps me keep fit. I've thought about skiing, but that's probably too expensive to be honest. I think I'll take up swimming though.
Friend: That makes sense. Then maybe you can do some painting next year.

Question 7. Which one is Uncle Jake?
Person 1: Look, have you seen these old photographs? They're amazing.
Person 2: Yes, look at that one. Dad with his long hair and beard, I think he looked terrible.
Person 1: I know. He looks funny. At least his hair was still dark then.
Person 2: Let's be honest. Uncle Jake wasn't much better. He had long hair too.
Person 1: And a moustache.
Person 2: And then there's Fred. I wonder why his hair wasn't long too. Long hair was the fashion.
Person 1: Maybe, but he was the only tidy one.
